description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective From 31.08.2020 to 06.09.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
